verses.text: Ix yalanxi jun chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, k'uxb'at jun b'aj tz'ib'ab'il juntzanh lolonel tik, tzach b'at al t'a masanil heb' etisraelal, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in jakan in ti', ix yak'an in k'uxb'at jun b'aj tz'ib'ab'il chi'.
Elanhchamel ix yal t'ayin: B'uk'em jun tz'ib'ab'il ix wak' tik t'ayach, sb'ut'jikanel a k'ol yuj, xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix in b'uk'emi, te chi' ix wab' icha nok' yalchab'.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, tzalan t'a heb' etisraelal jantak tas ol wal t'ayach.
Manh wanok ach in chekanb'at t'a skal heb' anima max yal halan sti', mato max nachaj u'uj, palta ha t'a heb' etchonhab' tzach in chekb'ati.
Manh wanok ach in chekanb'at t'a juntzanh nación b'aj tzijtum ti' tz'alchaji to ajaltak snachajel u'uj. Tato ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' tzach in chekb'ati, tzam scha yab' heb' tas tzala'.
Palta a heb' etchonhab' chi' jun, manh ol schalaj yab' heb' t'ayach, yujto malaj snib'ej heb' scha'an yab' tas swala', yujto te pit syutej spensar heb'.
Palta a in ol wak' a tek'anil t'a yichanh heb', yik ol a tek'b'an a b'a halan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb'.
Icha wal stzatzil k'e'en diamante, ma icha k'e'en yaxk'e'en ol ach wutok t'a yichanh heb'. Manh jab'ok ol ach xiw t'a heb' wach'chom skot wal yowal sat heb' yuj spital, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, maklej wal ab' tas ol wal t'ayach, tza sik'ankan t'a a pensar.

Ixik, tzach b'at b'aj ayek' heb' etchonhab' ik'b'ilkot preso, tzalan t'a heb', taxonhej scha yab' heb' tas ol ala', mato ma'ay, palta tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajalil, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'ancha'anh Yespíritu Dios, haxo t'a in patik ix wab' yoch jun aw icha sk'anh yek' kixkab', ix yalani: Alchajokab' wach'il t'a stzikikial Jehová b'aj ayek'i, xchi.
Ix wab'anpax sk'anh sk'axil heb' querubín ayik syil-lan sb'a. Ha juntzanh xokanxokan junnhej yaj yet' heb', sk'anhpaxi, xiwub'tak sk'anhi.
Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix in ik'ank'e wa'an, ix in yik'anb'ati. Te kusk'olal ix in aji, ix kot wowal, ix in b'ati. Haxo spoder Jehová ayoch t'ayin.

Ayik ix in k'och t'a chonhab' Tel-abib t'a sti' a niwan Quebar, haton b'aj kajan onh ek' mach onh ik'b'il onh kot icha preso tik, uke' k'ual majxo in lolonlaj, yujto ix sat in k'ol yuj tas ix wila'' yet' tas ix wab' chi'.
Ayik ix lajwi uke' k'ual chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ach anima, a in ix ach wak'och stanhwumalok heb' etchonhab' israel. Ayik ol walan in lolonel t'ayach, a hachxo ol al t'a heb' in k'exulok yik ol yojtakejel heb'.

Ayik ol walan t'a junok mach to ol cham yuj smul, tato a ach tik manh ol al t'ay, manh ol a kacha' yik syaktejkan chukal sk'ulej chi', yik max chami, ayik scham jun anima yuj smul chi', ha t'a ib'anh skan schamel chi' wu'uj.
Palta tato tzal t'ay jun, tza kachanpax t'a schukal chi', palta max yaktejkan schukal b'eyb'al chi', ol cham yuj smul chi', a schamel chi' max kanlaj t'a ib'anh.

Hanhejtona', tato ay junok mach wach' sb'eyb'al, palta syaktejkan swach' b'eyb'al chi', sk'ulan chukal, a in ol in cha swach' k'ulej chukal chi' masanto schami. Tato a ach tik max a kacha', tato schami, a tas wach' sk'ulejnak t'a yalanhtax chi' manhxalaj yelk'och t'a wichanh, ol cham yuj smul chi', palta haxo t'a ib'anh skan schamel chi' wu'uj.

Palta tato tza kach jun anima chi' jun yik max sk'ulej chukal chi', scha'an yab'i, maxtzak sk'ulej chukal chi'. Ha jun anima chi' olto pitzwok ek'i, yujto ix sk'anab'ajej b'aj ix a kach chi'. Ha hachxo tik tzach kolchajkani, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yak'ank'e sk'ab' Jehová t'a wib'anh, ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: K'e'anh wa'an, ixik t'a jun ak'lik chi'. Hata' ol in lolon t'ayach, xchi.
Ix in k'e wa'an b'i'an, ix in b'at t'a jun ak'lik chi'. Hata' ix wil stzikikial Jehová, icha ix aj wilan t'a sti' ha' niwan Quebar. Ix in julanem lachnaj in b'a t'a sat lu'um.
Ix och Yespíritu Dios chi' t'ayin, ix in yik'ank'e linhan, ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, tza makanoch a b'a t'a yol a pat.
Ach anima, ol ach tzek'chajkan t'a yol a pat, yik wach' maxtzak ach elta t'a skal heb' etchonhab'.
Ichato ol wak'kank'e lotzan ak' t'a a jo'om, yik wach' manhxo ol yal a loloni, manhxo ol yal a kachan heb', yujto te pit heb'.

Ayik ay tas snib'ej in k'ol ol ala', ol ach wak' lolonok, ol halani: Icha tik yalan Jehová Kajalil, xa chi. Ha mach snib'ej scha'an yab'i, yab'okab'i. Ha pax mach malaj snib'ej scha'an yab' jun, schumxo, yujto a jun chonhab' tik te pit, xchi Jehová.
